title: Concurrent downloads
description: Archives downloaded at the same time, 1–3. Each source is still paced separately.

title: Maximum archive size (MiB)
description: Larger archives are refused while downloading, 1–128.

title: Prefer no-video archives
description: Default for new queue entries. Mirrors honour it only when a no-video archive exists.

title: Stable Songs folder
description: Absolute folder for stable imports. Leave empty to use the Songs folder vosu reports for the attached client. Every import still asks for confirmation.

title: Hide sets you already have
description: Default for the results filter. Stable ownership comes from a read-only osu!.db copy; lazer ownership needs the Lazer library tool. Sets this tool already downloaded are hidden too.

title: Follow the current map
description: Re-run "same mapper" and "similar" searches when you select another beatmap in osu!.

title: Mirror sources (JSON)
description: Array of sources implementing the osu.direct API: name, base (HTTPS origin), enabled, priority (lower first), interval_ms (2000–60000), terms_url, automation_permitted. Enable a source only after checking its operator allows automated downloads. There is no automatic failover.

title: osu! API client ID
description: Your own OAuth client from osu! account settings. Needed only for the official metadata provider and beatmap packs.

title: osu! API client secret
description: Write-only: vosu passes it only to this tool's service, never to a browser page.
